decisions.reason: Requiring direct chat upload changes delivery mechanics but does not change the requirement to produce a UGC video artifact.
The delivery-channel impact is already fully represented by the existing message-31 MODIFY that replaces the accepted channels with DIRECT_CHAT_UPLOAD.
Changing from link delivery to direct chat upload does not alter the required spoken language.
The delivery instruction does not change the required filming setting or background.
The direct-upload instruction does not change the required opening performance involving reading from the phone.
The delivery-channel change does not alter screen-tap confidence or timing requirements.
The instruction to upload directly in chat does not modify the requirement to follow the supplied script.
The delivery-channel change does not alter the below-one-minute duration limit.
